ui.pageTitle: Lesson 4 Recap Quiz - Learn AI Anywhere
ui.introSubtitle: Test your knowledge of AI ethics and responsibility

questions.question: Why can bias in data lead to wrong predictions?
options: The machine refuses to process new data
The model focuses on feelings instead of numbers
The machine bases its prediction on a limited perspective
The machine forgets its training over time
questions.correctAnswer: The machine bases its prediction on a limited perspective

questions.question: Who is responsible when an AI tool makes a harmful mistake?
options: The humans who created or used it
questions.correctAnswer: The humans who created or used it

questions.question: What are ways humans can reduce harm from AI predictions?
options: Let the AI fix its own mistakes
Ignore errors and hope they improve
Use more AI models without changing anything

questions.question: Which of the following respects people's data privacy?
options: Sharing personal data with anyone who asks
Getting permission and using the data for the reason it was collected
Using data even if it's sensitive, as long as it helps the AI
questions.correctAnswer: Getting permission and using the data for the reason it was collected
